title: Loaded Pizza Bread
description: This loaded pizza bread with mozzarella, tomato sauce, olives, and pepperoni is the perfect Super Bowl snack.
ingredients: 1 (8 ounce) container garlic and herb cream cheese, softened
10 mini pepperoni slices, or to taste
2 tablespoons sliced black olives, or to taste
2 teaspoons chopped fresh parsley or basil

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Slice bread in half lengthwise and scoop out some of the center of the loaf and reserve for another use such as making breadcrumbs. Set loaf halves aside.

Combine herbed cream cheese, Parmesan cheese, and 1 cup mozzarella cheese in a bowl and stir until well combined. Divide cheese mixture between the two bread halves and spread in an even layer. Top evenly with cooked sausage. Divide sauce among each half, lightly spreading it to cover the sausage. Top with mini pepperoni, olives, and remaining cheese.
Wrap each loaf halve completely in foil, keeping the top slightly loose so it doesn't stick to the cheese.

Bake in the preheated oven until the cheeses are gooey and melted and the bread is golden and toasted, 25 to 30 minutes. Remove from the foil and let stand 5 minutes. Sprinkle with fresh parsley or basil and cut loaves in 2 inch thick slices.

video.description: In this video, learn how to make chef Nicole McLaughlin’s loaded pizza bread, the perfect appetizer for the big game. This Super Bowl party classic is not just another bread pizza. It’s more like a pizza topped with a delicious dip, resulting in an amazing total package. This recipe makes a perfect quick and easy appetizer, or you can pair it with a salad for a simple weeknight dinner that friends and family will love.
